# ankra_application_env_secret (Resource)

One key of an application's environment Secret, the values its generated manifests read through `secretKeyRef`. The counterpart of `ankra application env-secrets set` and `ankra application env-secrets delete`. Setting a value does not roll running workloads: the next deploy seals it, or run `ankra application env-secrets apply`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Terraform 1.11 or later: the value is write-only and never stored in state.
# Bump value_wo_version to write a new value.
resource "ankra_application_env_secret" "database_url" {
  application_id   = ankra_application.web.id
  key              = "DATABASE_URL"
  value_wo         = var.database_url
  value_wo_version = 1
}

# Older Terraform: value is stored in state in plain text, marked sensitive.
resource "ankra_application_env_secret" "api_token" {
  application_id = ankra_application.web.id
  key            = "API_TOKEN"
  value          = var.api_token
}

variable "database_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

variable "api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Identifier of the application. Changing it replaces the secret.
- `key` (String) Environment variable name: letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore, at most 63 characters. Changing it replaces the secret.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `value` (String, Sensitive) Secret value. It is stored in Terraform state in plain text (marked sensitive); on Terraform 1.11 or later prefer `value_wo`, which never reaches state. The platform never returns the value, so a value changed outside Terraform is not detected; a value deleted from the secret store outside Terraform is, and plans the secret again. Set exactly one of `value` and `value_wo`.
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret value as a write-only attribute (Terraform 1.11 or later): it is sent to the platform and never stored in plan or state. Terraform cannot see a change to it, so bump `value_wo_version` to write a new value.
- `value_wo_version` (Number) Version of `value_wo`. Changing it writes `value_wo` again. Required with `value_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<application_id>/<key>`.
- `status` (String) `set` while the secret store holds the value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by <application_id>/<key>. The value is never read back.
terraform import ankra_application_env_secret.database_url 5b0c4a9e-2f43-4b8e-9a51-1f0d8e7c2a10/DATABASE_URL
```
